import pathlib
base=pathlib.Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1792545471/attempts/cb5c46cb9eb34b0fb84b0c3660206bd3/system/state/workspace/programs'); base.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
def transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0]); out=[r[:] for r in grid]
    for color in set(v for row in grid for v in row)-{9}:
        pts=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c]==color]
        if len(pts)<2: continue
        # derive directional vector from any pair in same line, closest pair
        pairs=[]
        for i,(r,c) in enumerate(pts):
            for rr,cc in pts[i+1:]:
                dr,dc=rr-r,cc-c
                if dr==0: step=(0,1 if dc>0 else -1)
                elif dc==0: step=(1 if dr>0 else -1,0)
                elif abs(dr)==abs(dc): step=(1 if dr>0 else -1,1 if dc>0 else -1)
                else: continue
                pairs.append((abs(dr)+abs(dc),r,c,step))
        if not pairs: continue
        _,r,c,(dr,dc)=min(pairs)
        # generate along line both directions, stopping at bounds or other colors
        for sign in (-1,1):
            rr,cc=r,c
            while 0<=rr+sign*dr<h and 0<=cc+sign*dc<w:
                rr+=sign*dr; cc+=sign*dc
                if out[rr][cc] not in (9,color): break
                out[rr][cc]=color
    return out

path.write_text(src)
